ads-callout: <ads-callout>Keep the working surface central and reveal tools when needed.</ads-callout>
ads-card:
Untitled project

A simple content container. Your application supplies the data and actions.
ads-checkbox-group:
<ads-checkbox-group name="tools" label="Enabled tools" required>
  <ads-checkbox value="map" checked>Map</ads-checkbox>
  <ads-checkbox value="search">Search</ads-checkbox>
  <ads-checkbox value="export" disabled>Export</ads-checkbox>
</ads-checkbox-group>
ads-field:
<ads-field label="Email address" required>
  <input slot="control" type="email" name="email" required />
  <ads-description slot="description">Used for project invitations.</ads-description>
</ads-field>
ads-input: A name for your next idea.
ads-number-input: <ads-number-input name="quantity" label="Quantity" value="2" min="1" max="10" step="1"></ads-number-input>
ads-radio:
<ads-radio-group label="Choice" value="one">
  <ads-radio value="one">First option</ads-radio>
  <ads-radio value="two">Second option</ads-radio>
</ads-radio-group>
ads-radio-group:
<ads-radio-group name="plan" label="Plan" value="personal">
  <ads-radio value="personal">Personal</ads-radio>
  <ads-radio value="team">Team</ads-radio>
  <ads-radio value="enterprise" disabled>Enterprise</ads-radio>
</ads-radio-group>
ads-search-input: <ads-search-input name="query" label="Search projects" placeholder="Find a project…"></ads-search-input>
ads-select:
<ads-select name="plan" label="Plan" value="personal">
  <option value="personal">Personal</option>
  <option value="team">Team</option>
  <option value="enterprise" disabled>Enterprise</option>
</ads-select>
ads-textarea: <ads-textarea name="notes" label="Notes" value="Make room for the work."></ads-textarea>
ads-toast: Document saved.
